description: Asks whether each date and information builtin is available in the DAO query context and what it returns at month-end, leap-day, week-setting, out-of-range, negative-fraction and Null inputs, plus the VarType/TypeName reported for literal forms, each call its own SELECT. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
